items.note: The opening sentence asks whether the July 2026 Pro price increase (49 to 69 USD) drove Pro churn.
The prompt says to exclude trials (is_trial = yes).
The prompt says to exclude internal test accounts (emails ending in @ourco.test).
The prompt says an account has churned if it has a cancel_month.
The question is framed as the CEO's, and the output is to be written for the CEO.
The prompt asks for a summary of at most 5 bullets.
The prompt asks for one suggested chart and says to specify the axes, the groups and the metric.
The prompt notes the sample is small and asks how confident the conclusion is and why.

invented: The prompt says to drop both trials and test accounts silently and not report the excluded rows. The user only said the @ourco.test accounts need no separate reporting. They said nothing about leaving trials unreported.
